records.name: Lawyer
records.description: Provides legal advice or representation, for example a solicitor or attorney. Covers legal practitioners rather than every employee of a law firm.

records.name: Doctor
records.description: Practises human medicine, for example a general practitioner or surgeon. Doctor here means medical practitioner, not an academic doctorate holder; dentists and veterinarians have separate codes.

records.name: Nurse
records.description: Provides nursing care, for example a community or hospital nurse. Distinct from a doctor or a non-nursing care worker.

records.name: Dentist
records.description: Provides dental assessment and treatment, for example a general dentist. Distinct from a dental assistant or medical doctor.

records.name: Pharmacist
records.description: Works in medicines dispensing or pharmacy practice, for example a community pharmacist. Distinct from a pharmacy retail assistant.

records.name: Physiotherapist
records.description: Provides physical rehabilitation and movement therapy, for example rehabilitation after an injury. Also called a physical therapist; distinct from a fitness trainer.

records.name: Psychologist
records.description: Works in psychological assessment, research or interventions, for example a clinical psychologist. Distinct from a psychiatrist, who is a medical doctor.

records.name: Veterinarian
records.description: Provides medical care for animals, for example a companion-animal vet. Distinct from a human medical doctor or animal groomer.

records.name: Accountant
records.description: Prepares, examines or advises on financial accounts, for example a tax accountant. Distinct from a financial adviser recommending financial plans.

records.name: Financial adviser
records.description: Advises on financial planning and financial decisions, for example retirement planning. Distinct from accounting or merely selling a financial product.

records.name: Insurance broker
records.description: Arranges insurance cover for clients, for example a commercial insurance broker. Describes the person’s work, not an insurance policy or product.

records.name: Real estate agent
records.description: Helps clients buy, sell or lease property, for example a residential estate agent. Distinct from an architect or building contractor.

records.name: Engineer
records.description: Designs, develops or evaluates engineered systems, for example a civil or mechanical engineer. Software developers have a separate code; both can apply when relevant.

records.name: Architect
records.description: Designs buildings and their spatial organization, for example a residential architect. Does not mean a software architect or every building designer.

records.name: Software developer
records.description: Creates and maintains software, for example an application programmer or software engineer. Distinct from general IT support.

records.name: IT specialist
records.description: Supports or administers computing systems, networks or security, for example a systems administrator. Software development is classified separately when that is the work being described.

records.name: Scientist
records.description: Conducts scientific research, for example a laboratory biologist or physicist. Distinct from a teacher whose primary work is teaching science.

records.name: Teacher
records.description: Teaches learners in an educational setting, for example a school teacher or private tutor. University lecturers have a separate code.

records.name: Lecturer
records.description: Teaches in higher education, for example a university lecturer or teaching professor. Research work may additionally be classified as Scientist.

records.name: Designer
records.description: Creates visual, digital or product designs, for example a graphic or interaction designer. Building architecture has a separate code.

records.name: Artist
records.description: Creates works of art, for example a painter or sculptor. Photography, music and design have separate codes where those better describe the work.

records.name: Writer
records.description: Creates written works, for example a novelist or copywriter. Journalists have a separate code for news reporting.

records.name: Journalist
records.description: Researches and reports news, for example a newspaper reporter. Distinct from other writing such as fiction or advertising copy.

records.name: Photographer
records.description: Creates photographs professionally, for example a portrait photographer. Does not classify someone merely because they take personal photographs.

records.name: Musician
records.description: Performs or creates music, for example a pianist or composer. Music teaching can additionally use Teacher.

records.name: Electrician
records.description: Installs, maintains or repairs electrical wiring and equipment, for example domestic wiring. Distinct from electrical engineering design.

records.name: Plumber
records.description: Installs, maintains or repairs water, drainage and related pipe systems, for example domestic plumbing. Distinct from general building work.

records.name: Carpenter
records.description: Builds, installs or repairs wooden structures and fittings, for example cabinetry or framing. Distinct from general building contracting.

records.name: Builder
records.description: Carries out or coordinates building construction, for example a residential building contractor. Specialized trades can use their own codes.

records.name: Mechanic
records.description: Maintains and repairs vehicles or machinery, for example an automotive mechanic. Distinct from engineering design.

records.name: Chef
records.description: Prepares food professionally, for example a restaurant chef or cook. Distinct from a restaurant owner whose work is management.

records.name: Hairdresser
records.description: Cuts, styles or treats hair, for example a salon stylist or barber. Distinct from other beauty services.

records.name: Fitness trainer
records.description: Guides exercise and physical conditioning, for example a personal trainer. Distinct from physiotherapy rehabilitation.

records.name: Translator
records.description: Converts written content between languages, for example a document translator. Spoken or signed interpretation has a separate code.

records.name: Interpreter
records.description: Converts spoken or signed communication between languages, for example a conference interpreter. Distinct from written translation.

records.name: Social worker
records.description: Supports people with social needs and access to services, for example a family social worker. Distinct from clinical psychology or nursing.
